movie.title: Summer's Last Resort
movie.overview: Determined to save her mom from another bad relationship, a teen accidentally turns a luxury vacation into total chaos.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: When a determined teenager tries to sabotage her mother's latest romance during a lavish getaway, her interference triggers a hilarious cascade of unexpected chaos.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: An overprotective teenager is driven by a single mission: preventing her mom from making another disastrous mistake in love. When her mother falls for a charismatic suitor at a high-end luxury resort, the teen steps in to orchestrate a series of subtle sabotages. However, her well-meaning schemes quickly snowball into total turmoil, entangling guests and staff alike in the mess. Ultimately, she must navigate the fallout while learning to trust her mother's choices and opening herself up to unexpected romance.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Summer's Last Resort follows the story of an overly protective teenager who is haunted by her mother's long history of heartbreak and poor romantic choices. Determined to break the cycle once and for all, she tags along on an opulent tropical vacation when her mother is courted by a charming new boyfriend. Viewing the man with intense suspicion, the teen embarks on a covert crusade to expose his flaws and ruin the burgeoning romance before it gets serious. She recruits an unsuspecting local resort employee to assist in her increasingly elaborate schemes, ranging from staged awkward encounters to grand public embarrassing moments. However, as her plans constantly backfire, the peaceful luxury retreat descends into hilarious, unpredictable chaos that draws in other resort guests. Amidst the madness, the teen discovers that her co-conspirator might actually be someone special, forcing her to confront her own fear of intimacy. Meanwhile, her mother begins to realize the true motivation behind her daughter's frantic actions, leading to an emotional confrontation. In the end, the teen comes to realize that protecting her mother doesn't mean controlling her life, allowing both women to embrace love on their own terms.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Haunted by her mother's history of terrible romantic choices, a fiercely protective teenager goes to extreme lengths to stop history from repeating itself. When her mom is swept off her feet by a charming new suitor at an exclusive tropical getaway, the teen launches a covert mission to sabotage the relationship before it leads to another heartbreak. Enlisting the help of a charming resort insider, her scheming quickly spins out of control, turning a serene paradise into a chaotic battlefield of misplaced intentions, blossoming young love, and poignant family drama.

story_structure.climax: The cumulative meddling reaches a breaking point during a major resort event, threatening to exposed her actions and blow up the family dynamic completely.
story_structure.conflict: When her initial attempts to intervene hit a wall, she hatches a secretive plan to steer her mother away from the new love interest.
story_structure.resolution: In the aftermath of the chaos, honest conversations force a shift in understanding between mother and daughter regarding trust, boundaries, and growth.
story_structure.introduction: A protective teenager arrives at a high-end vacation getaway, determined to keep her mother from plunging into yet another disastrous romantic relationship.
story_structure.risingAction: Her covert scheming spiraling out of control, she triggers a series of unintended mishaps that turn the peaceful resort vacation into utter chaos.
